name: Autumn Task API
description: Durable research tasks run by a sandboxed agent. Auth on every request: `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. JSON over HTTP; `/stream` routes are server-sent events. Errors share one body: branch on `error`, retry when `retryable` is true.
